strokeOrder: draw the short upper head from left to right
continue down and around the deep bowl without lifting
lift once, then place the dot above

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, خ demonstration at 00:49–00:54 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated خ body-first: the short upper head travels left to right, then the same pen-down run turns through the hooked descent and deep bowl. After completing the body, the writer lifts once and places the single dot above. Contextual joins reshape the head; this isolated Persian learner path fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and retains Persian-scoped provenance rather than borrowing the separate Arabic or Urdu خ sources.
